$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/stockcount.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office writes stock counts and their lines through apps/factory-api's modules/inventory/counts (B-W2a-15), always through command(): it creates a count, freezes the expected quantities, types what was counted, asks for recounts, submits, approves or sends back, applies the differences as COUNT moves through the ledger, and signs off the year-end inventory. W2b-5 (schema wave 36/44, B-W2b-277): the floor counts by scan (floor.count, SCM-228) on its OWN site: it reads the site's counts and their lines, adds the extra units it finds while a count is COUNTING (ADDED lines, expected 0) and writes what it counted and recounted (the lines carry no cost column for that reason; the …_warehouse_depth_w2b_guards redefinition of the line trigger keeps a floor session to those columns, and takes a lock instead of the count row FOR SHARE, which the floor's grant does not allow). The count's value of its differences is a cost (`@grain cost`): office only. Portal and link sessions read nothing. From SUBMITTED on the lines are history (the …_stock_plan_w2a_guards triggers refuse every change but the move each line posts, for every login); nobody deletes a count (it is cancelled), and the office deletes a line only while its count is DRAFT or COUNTING. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

StockCount.about: The office opens a cycle count or the year-end inventory of a site, starts it (the snapshot), submits, approves or sends it back, applies its differences, signs off a year-end count and cancels one before it is applied. W2b-5: the floor reads its own site's counts (what to count; the value of the differences, a cost, hidden).

StockCountLine.about: The office writes a count's lines (the snapshot, the counts, recounts and reasons) while the count is DRAFT or COUNTING, deletes an added line then, and names the COUNT move a line posted while the count is APPROVED. W2b-5: the site's floor reads the lines, adds an extra unit it found (an ADDED line) and writes what it counted and recounted, while the count is COUNTING.
